assumptions.choice: Use the specified full-position fallback exit at TP2.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives no allocation among TP1, TP2, TP3, and TP4, so partial-exit sizing cannot be determined.

assumptions.choice: Use the entry signal bar Close.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader market orders fill on the following bar, whose price is unknown when the required position size is calculated.

assumptions.choice: Treat TP2 and SMA(50) as touched when High reaches them, and the stop as triggered when Low reaches it; stop has precedence if both occur in one OHLC bar.
assumptions.reason: Daily OHLC bars do not provide intrabar ordering.

assumptions.choice: Exit orders are submitted with self.close() after the triggering daily bar is observed.
assumptions.reason: A strategy cannot retroactively execute a market close at an intrabar touch using only completed daily OHLC bars.
